feature_graph.graph_summary: The part is a small axisymmetric cold-formed leakdown plunger, drawing 359110 rev A, made from C10C material with no heat treatment and estimated mass 2.3 g. The finished envelope is cylindrical, about 9.65 mm long with maximum OD Ø9.12±0.025; this OD establishes datum A and carries circularity, straightness, and perpendicularity controls. The left and right end faces are interpreted as datums C and B respectively. Internally, SECTION A-A shows a coaxial stepped bore/valve-seat system with a large right-end internal cavity Ø7.18±0.1, an inner Ø4 bore, a reduced Ø2.4±0.15 orifice, a left Ø4.763 chamber, and a spherical seat/cavity SØ3.175. DETAIL B defines the local seat/lip geometry with Ø6.88±0.05 significant diameter, Ø7±0.1 formed diameter, 0.76±0.1 land, 15°±2° taper, and several local radii. External edges include a left chamfer range 0.28/0.47×45° with optional 22° and a right R0.25±0.13 edge radius. Notes require leakage check to 10 SCCM max, clean/dry valve seat, no raised metal in the detailed lip area, and all sharp corners broken 0.25 max.

clarifications.question: Confirm whether the SECTION A-A callout Ø7.18±0.1 is the large right-end internal bore/cavity diameter, rather than an external reduced diameter or another internal form diameter.
clarifications.why_it_matters: The extension lines are small in the raster image, and this affects feature classification, wall thickness interpretation, and bore/cavity depth.
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat Ø7.18±0.1 as a coaxial internal right-end cavity controlled to datum A.

clarifications.question: Confirm the exact axial depths/termination points of the Ø7.18 cavity, Ø4 bore, Ø2.4 orifice, and Ø4.763 left chamber in the stepped internal profile.
clarifications.why_it_matters: The section shows a stepped profile and local axial dimensions 1.26, 1.52, and 2.33, but the exact start/end mapping of each bore segment is not fully clear from the raster image.
clarifications.suggested_default: Use the SECTION A-A geometry as a stepped coaxial bore system and apply visible axial coordinates to the left seat/orifice region.

clarifications.question: Confirm datum feature attachments for boxed B and C: C as the left end face and B as the right end face.
clarifications.why_it_matters: The boxed letters are visible but the small datum leader/attachment geometry is not as clear as datum A; datum interpretation affects GD&T relationships.
clarifications.suggested_default: Use C = left end face and B = right end face.

clarifications.question: Confirm that the feature-control symbols reading as ↗ 0.2 A, ↗ 0.25 A, and ↗ 0.04 A are circular runout controls rather than another ISO orientation/profile symbol.
clarifications.why_it_matters: The symbol is legible as a runout-like arrow in the raster, but precise GD&T type affects inspection interpretation.
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat these as runout controls to datum A.

clarifications.question: Confirm whether circled dimensions 1.73 and 6.48 above the lower side view define an OD form-control zone start and length/span, or are special/significant dimensions with another convention.
clarifications.why_it_matters: They are not hole callouts and do not include Ø, but their exact function affects the controlled axial zone of the OD.
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat 1.73 as the start coordinate and 6.48 as the length/span of the OD form-controlled zone.

guardrail_results.message: Title block, material, heat treatment, mass, drawing number, revision, general tolerances, and notes were extracted before feature analysis.
No ordinate dimensioning is used. Envelope length is taken from the maximum axial length 9.65±0.13 in SECTION A-A and maximum diameter from Ø9.12±0.025 in the side view.
Full scan found no M-series or other thread callouts on the drawing.
No hole features were created from count-like values without Ø. Circled 1.73 and 6.48 and all plain axial values were treated as dimensions, not holes.
Stepped internal bore/chamber depths are visible in section but exact segment start/end mapping is ambiguous; clarification questions were added instead of inventing depths.
Section A-A cutting-plane labels were separated from datum feature symbols. Datum A is OD/axis; B and C are interpreted as right/left end faces.
All extracted feature nodes have at least one relationship; coaxial/opposite-face relationships are represented bidirectionally where appropriate.
